```bash
echo 'alias enable_routing="echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward"' | sudo tee -a /etc/bash.bashrc && source /etc/bash.bashrc
```

This command appends the alias to the `/etc/bash.bashrc` file and then sources the file to make the alias available in the current session. Make sure you have the necessary permissions to modify the `/etc/bash.bashrc` file.

I cannot execute commands directly, but I can guide you on how to do it.

To run the command you provided, open your terminal and enter the following:

Make sure you have the necessary permissions to modify system settings. You may need to run this command with `sudo` if you encounter permission issues.
